definition: [ יָאַשׁ ] verb despair (not in Qal ) (Late Hebrew Hithpa`el despair of , יֵאוּשׁ desperation ; Aramaic Pa`el יָאֵשׁ , etc., make despair (so ᵑ7 Eccl 2:20 ); Arabic despair ) — Niph`al Perfect וְנוֺאַש consecutive 1Sam 27:1 Participle נוֺאָשׁ Jer 2:25 + 3 t.; — despair , מִמֶּנִּי שָׁאוּל ׳ וְנ לְבַקְּשֵׁנִי 1Sam 27:1 and Saul shall despair of me, to seek me ; participle desperate, despairing , of Job, Job 6:26 elsewhere נוֺאָ֑שׁ (following אמר ) desperate! = there is no hope! Jer 2:25 ; Jer 18:12 ; Isa 57:10 . Pi`el Infinitive לְיַאֵשׁ אֶתלִֿבִּי עַל כָּלהֶֿעָמָל Eccl 2:20 to make my heart despair, concerning all the toil. יאֹשִׁיָּ֫הוּ , יאֹשִׁיָּה see below אשׁה above
